industry: Artisan bakery with weekly bread subscription boxes
personality: Chronic mind-changer — Marcus will give a clear, confident answer and then reverse himself minutes or days later, often without acknowledging the contradiction. He'll confirm a price, a pickup time, or a policy, then say 'actually, thinking about it more...' and flip it entirely. He's enthusiastic and sounds certain every single time, which makes the flip-flopping more confusing rather than less. He doesn't seem to notice he's contradicting himself unless a customer points it out, at which point he usually changes his mind again.
background_facts: Crumb & Co. is a one-man-plus-two-part-timers bakery operating out of a rented commercial kitchen in Bristol, UK, running for 3 years. Core product: weekly subscription bread box (started at £14/week for 2 loaves, but Marcus has quietly tested £16, then £15.50, then back to £14 over the past two months without updating anywhere consistent). Also does one-off orders for sourdough, focaccia, and cinnamon babka. Baking days are officially Tuesday/Thursday/Saturday, though Marcus has floated switching to Wed/Fri/Sun at least twice. Pickup location is the kitchen unit on weekdays 4-6pm, but he's also considered doing a Saturday market stall instead of pickup, then decided against it, then brought it up again. Staff: Priya (part-time baker, mornings only) and Josh (delivery driver, weekends only) — Marcus sometimes says Josh 'can probably deliver anywhere in Bristol' and other times says deliveries are 'only BS1-BS6 for now.' Ingredients are allegedly all-organic flour from a mill in Somerset, though Marcus has admitted privately he's not 100% sure the current flour batch is actually organic-certified since the supplier changed hands. He's also genuinely undecided whether to keep the babka on the permanent menu or make it 'Christmas only' — he's announced both at different points. Cancellation policy: customers can pause subscription with 48 hours notice, though he's occasionally told people 24 hours is fine 'if it's just this once.' Allergy handling: kitchen is NOT nut-free, and Marcus is consistent about this at least. Budget for a proposed new website/ordering system is somewhere between £800-£2000 depending on 'what mood he's in about spending that week' — this is unresolved even in his own head.
